transcript: I feel like my ideal future society would be one very similar to ours now, but maybe a little more technologically innovative. I feel like I don't want one centered around AI because that just takes a lot of people's sense of choice out of the picture or relying on technology to run our society um but i think one where we combine um one where we combine our our current society with um using technology as a tool rather than the only being the only thing that guides us is the one that will help us the most both looking at it from an ecological standpoint a lawful standpoint um and just a happiness standpoint.
